tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i sa chog dang sta gon 'don bya khol du phyung ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma mchog dang 'jig rten dbang phyug la// gus pas phyag 'tshal de nyid sgrub pa'i zin// gang zhig blo gros gzhon nu gang zag rnams// sngon gyi phyags srol ji ltar gsungs pa ltar// 'jug pa bde ba'i lam srol rab gsal ba// 'dir zhugs dang ba'i nyams su blang bar mdzod// de la thog mar/ rang nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pad+ma/ g.yon bgrang phreng 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa gsal bar gyur/ oṃ hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛ ta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ rang gi thugs ka nas/ yaṃ 'phros pa las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam ba dan dang yaṃ yig gis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ spros pa las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po 'bar ba raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de la kaṃ gsum spros pa las thod pa skam po bum ril gyi sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du/ a spros pa las thod pa'i snod phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ dbus su mu las dri chu baiḍūr+ya lta bu/ shar du bi las dri chen shel lta bu/ lhor ra las rak+ta gser btso ma lta bu/ nub tu shu las byang sems dkar po/ byang du ma las klad pa ste bdud rtsi lnga dang*/ slar yang dbus su na las mi'i sha /shar lhor go las ba glang gi sha /lho nub tu ku las khyi'i sha /nub byang du da las glang po che'i sha /byang shar du ha las rta'i sha ste sha lnga'o// rlung g.yos shing me sbar bas thod pa dros rdzas rnams zhu ba/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsung gi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin kha dog dmar po'o// oṃ āḥhūm̐/

thugs kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin kha dog sngon po'o// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sku'i bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin kha dog dkar po 'o ma'i rgya mtsho lta bur gyur/ bgegs gtor la/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi gtor zhing*/ oṃ hrīḥ sogs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ rang rang gi spyod yul du gyur pa'i snod rnams su/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las byung ba/ lha rdzas las grub pa'i gtor ma dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ād+ya nut+pan+na tātwa oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum// sa slong ba ni/ gtor ma gcig bshams la/ sngon 'gro ltar byin gyis brlabs/ na ma sarba ta thā ga te bh+yo sogs gsum gyis 'bul/ dril bu gsil zhing*/ gang yang 'dir gnas lha dang klu// gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan yang rung*// dkyil 'khor don du sa 'di ni// bdag zhu khyed kyis stsal du gsol/ lan gsum/ zhes gsol ba btab pas gnang ba byin par gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su dri'i thig le byas pa'i steng du/ me tog gi tshom bu gru bzhi pa byas pa'i mtha' bskor du mchod yon/ nyer spyod lngas bskor ba bshams/ bdud rtsi gtor zhing*/ oṃ hrīḥ sogs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du baṃ las sa'i lha mo sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas na rin po che/ g.yon na rin po che'i bum pa bsnams pa/ sku la rin po che'i rgyan dang ldan pa/ sku phyed thon pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par aḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ dam tshig pa lta bu'i ye shes pa spyan drangs dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ pṛ thi wī de wa tā badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pa nas/ shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod/ g.yon dril bu 'dzin cing*/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i/

thal mo snying gar bzhag nas/ khyod ni sa 'dzin lha mo ste// sku phyed thon te gser gyi mdog /rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis brgyan// sa 'og lha mo khyod la bstod// pad+ma'i steng na bum pa 'dzin// gser mdog bstan pa srung mdzad ma// khyod ni nor 'dzin rgyal mo ste// nor 'dzin lha mor phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi// sa dang pha rol phyin pa la// lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur// skyob pa shākya seng ge yis// ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom ltar// de bzhin du ni bdud kyi sde// pham par bya phyir dkyil 'khor bris// rdo rje 'dzin pa khyod ci bde bar gyis shig ces gnang ba byin par gyur/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs nas dam tshig pa rang gi gnas su thim par gyur/ mchod gtor tshom bu rnams bsal/ sa'i lha mo'i sta gon no// lag gnyis rdo rje dril bu dang bcas pa'i mkhrig ma gnyis bsnol te sa la bzhag nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'og thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ logs thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba/ steng thams cad rdo rje'i gur du gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes brjod la/ lag gnyis kyis thal mo kha sbubs pas sa la reg cing bdag gir bzung ngo*/ sngo 'a༈༈༈ sngon 'gro gtor ma bshams nas/ oṃ hrīḥpad+man+ta krita sogs/ bdag bskyed kyis bzlas pa'i bar bya/ oṃ hrīḥ sogs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ a las thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i rdo rje'i mchod yon/ bdug spos/ me tog /mar me/ dri chab/

zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod pa'i sprin dwangs shing thogs pa med pa phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed rgyas par 'gengs shing 'phro ba/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams su gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs/ byin gyis brlabs/ shar phyogs pa rnams sangs rgyas spyan ma'i nga rgyal gyis/ me tog bdug spos snang gsal dang*// dri chab zhal zas mchis pa kun// bla ma dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul// bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra puṣ+pe pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ dhū pe= ā lo ke= gan+dhe= nai wid+ye pū dza me gha sogs/ thal mo snying gar bzhag pa gus pa'i tshul gyis/ hrīḥ thugs rje chen po 'jig rten dbang phyug sku// sku mdog dmar gsal 'jig rten dbang du sdud// spyan gyi 'od zer 'gro la thugs rjes gzigs// zhal nas hūm̐ sgras stong gsum chos sgra sgrog /shangs nas ye shes rlung gis nyon mongs 'thor// snyan gnyis thabs dang shes rab 'dul thabs mdzad// phyag gnyis dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med sbyor// g.yas pas bgrang phreng byang chub lam sna 'dren// g.yon pas pad+ma 'khor ba'i skyon dang bral// zhabs gnyis 'gro ba'i don la snyoms par bzhugs// rin chen rgyan drug pha rol phyin drug ldan// 'gro rnams ma lus thugs rjes dbang du sdud// 'jig rten dbang phyug sku la phyag 'tshal lo// dgyes par rol pas 'dzab bstod mchod pa bzhes// dbang dang dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol// gsung gi dbang phyug snang ba mtha' yas sku// 'chi med tshe dbang mgon po 'od dpag med// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad gsung las sprul// sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs// mi dmigs don gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol//

zhes pa'i bar gyis bstod la/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog /dkyil 'khor gtso bos bshad du gsol/ /lho phyogs pa rnams mā ma kī'i nga rgyal gyis/ gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro// reg dang 'dod yon rnam lnga po// bla ma dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul// bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rū pa pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ shab+da= gan+dhe= ra sa= spar+she pū dza me gha sogs/ hrīḥ thugs rje chen po 'jig rten dbang phyug sku// zhes sogs kyis bstod la/ mtshan rnams thams cad yang dag rdzogs// mtshan nyid min pa thams cad spangs// kun tu bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor gtso bos bshad du gsol// nub phyogs pa rnams gos dkar mo'i nga rgyal gyis/ sha chen spos dang dri yi byug /zhun chen snang gsal dri chen gyi// zhal zas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga// bla ma dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pañtsa a mṛ ta pañtsa aṃ ku sha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ hrīḥ thugs rje chen po sogs kyis bstod la/ zhi ba'i mchog ni chos las byung*// ye shes spyod pa rnam sbyong ba// kun tu bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor gtso bos bshad du gsol/ /byang phyogs pa rnams dam tshig sgrol ma'i nga rgyal gyis/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa 'di// bde chen kun tu bde chen nyid// 'khor 'das kun khyab kun tu bzang*// bla ma dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta na tad ma hā su kha tā pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ hrīḥ thugs rje chen po sogs kyis bstod la/ sems can kun gyi sems chen po// rang bzhin dag pas gos pa med// kun bzang thugs mchog kha lo sgyur// dkyil 'khor gtso bos bshad du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab nas/

slob dpon sems can rnams la snying brtse bas langs te/ rang nyid skad cig gis/ khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog he ru ka sku mdog dmar po phyag g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon sdigs mdzub rdo rje'i zhags pa bsnams pa/ sbrul dang dar gyi cod pan dang*/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ stag lpags rlon pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum dor stabs su 'gying ba/ shin tu khro ba'i zhal can/ spyan gsum khro gnyer gyi rlabs dang ldan pa/ mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/ sku la bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa'i gseb nas rta mgo ljang zhur rta skad 'tsher zhing gar byed pa tsam gyis dpa' bo rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor bar gsal ba'i mig g.yas pa ma las nyi ma/ g.yon pa ṭa las zla ba/ rkang pa gnyis hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rjer gyur/ dbyangs dang bcas pas/ e ma 'o sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// thugs rje can gyi thabs can gyis// zhi yang sems can 'dul don du// dri ma med pa'i khro bor sprul// rnam dag dbyings las thugs rje chen por sprul// skye med chos las 'jigs med skur ston pa'i// gdug pa 'dul phyir thugs dam rtse gcig nyid// khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes brjod cing phyag byas la/ rdo rje'i 'gros kyis dkyil 'khor gyi byang shar gyi mtshams su song ste/ 'gying bag dang bcas pas rdo rje gsor zhing*/ bgegs la bka' bsgo ba ni/ sa'i phyogs nam mkha' ltar yangs shing rgya che ba'i gnas 'dir/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rdo rje 'dzin pa bdag gis slob ma rnams la byang chub sems dpa' gsung gi mnga' bdag spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi dbang bskur byed pa la gang dag mi bzod pa'i gdon gyi rigs su gyur pa/ steng lha'i gdon dang*/ 'og klu'i gdon dang*/ bar lha ma yin gyi gdon dang*/ gdon chen po bco brgyad la sogs pa/ gang dag mi bzod cing ma rungs pa'i sems dang ldan pa de dag rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' thos pa tsam gyis phyir dengs shig

/gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag ni/ bdag gi ye shes kyi rdo rje me rab tu 'bar ba 'dis rab tu khros pa'i dbang gis mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ta re/ hūm̐/ zhes rol mo bya zhing bgegs bskrad do/ ༈ /lha sta gon ni/ dkyil 'khor dbus su chang dang dri bzang sbyar ba'i thig le mtho gang gru bzhi pa/ phyogs mtshams rnams su zlum po sor bzhi pa byas pa'i steng dri'i chus sbangs pa'i me tog gi tshom bu bkod mchod pas bskor la/ me tog tshom bu'i gdan gyi steng du hrīḥdamar po las bcom ldan 'das spyan ras gzigs 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal ba rgya mtsho sku mdog dmar po zhes pa nas/ sku la rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o// zhes pa'i bar lha bskyed/ rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas/ bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug gi lha tshogs rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs par gyur/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i rgyas/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ/ mchod yon bdug spos me tog snang gsal dri// zhes pas mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ mchod pa byin rlabs gong bzhin/ rdzas la bdud rtsi gtor nas sngar ltar byin gyis brlabs/ phyi'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ rgyal ba'i sku la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang*// sems can nyon mongs bag chags sbyang slad du// sku gsung thugs la khrus chab 'di gsol bas// khams gsum gnas pa'i dri ma dag gyur cig /oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra na sa ma ye hūm̐/ tshul khrims dri ldan spos mchog dam pa 'di// ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs nas// sangs rgyas zhing du spos dri ngad ldan pas// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams mnyes gyur cig /oṃ āḥ sogs sngags thog mtha' 'gre ba'i/ badz+ra dhū pe= dkyil 'khor kun tu rgyal ba mnyes byed pa'i// lha rdzas dbyibs legs me tog dam pa 'di// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis mngon sprul nas// gzhal yas khang du sprin bzhin gtibs gyur cig

/puṣ+pe sogs/ nyon mongs dug sreg ma rig mun sel ba'i// shes rab gzi ldan dpal gyi sgron me 'di// sprin med mkha' la nyi shar ji bzhin du// 'od zer snang bas phyogs bcur gsal gyur cig /ā lo ke sogs/ stong gsum kun tu dri dang ngad ldan pa'i// spos dang sman sbyar chu gtsang rgyal ba'i khrus// ye shes sprin phung mkha' la thugs rje'i char rgyun gyis// mi gtsang dri ma'i tshogs rnams dag gyur cig /gan+dhe sogs/ rgyal ba'i sku la bkres pa mi mnga' yang*// 'gro ba'i don du lha rdzas bdud rtsi'i bshos// dag cing gtsang mar bshams te 'bul lags na// bsod nams zhing gyur rnams kyis bzhes su gsol// nai wid+ya sogs/ dril chen sil snyan rnam grol tshangs pa'i dbyangs// bsam dag ngag gis bstod de gus mchod 'bul// sa bcu rim gyis bgrod nas sangs rgyas sar// tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas chos kyi rgyal por shog /shab+da sogs/ rol mo bya/ sa khams rang bzhin gti mug rnam par dag /gzugs phung gnas gyur chos dbyings ye shes bdag /bde gshegs kun dngos mgon po spyan ras gzigs// rnam par snang mdzad sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// nam mkha'i rang bzhin zhe sdang rnam par dag /rnam shes gnas gyur me long ye shes bdag /bde gshegs kun dngos mgon po spyan ras gzigs// mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// me khams rang bzhin nga rgyal rnam par dag /tshor ba gnas gyur mnyam nyid ye shes bdag /bde gshegs kun dngos mgon po spyan ras gzigs// rin chen 'byung ldan sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// chu khams rang bzhin 'dod chags rnam par dag /'du shes gnas gyur sor rtog ye shes bdag /bde gshegs kun dngos mgon po spyan ras gzigs// 'od dpag med mgon sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// rlung khams rang bzhin phrag dog rnam par dag /'du byed gnas gyur bya sgrub ye shes bdag /bde gshegs kun dngos mgon po spyan ras gzigs// don yod grub pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod//

ces bstod/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi blangs nas yi ge bcu pa'i rjes su/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ btags pas nam mkhar mchod/ pus btsugs rdor dril dang spos 'dzin pas/ gnyis med ye shes las byung ba'i// ston pa'i gtso bo spyan ras gzigs// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// lha rnams la ni mchod pa dang*// sems can rnams la phan pa'i phyir// rdo rje 'dzin pa bdag gis ni// dkyil 'khor dam pa bri bar 'tshal// rjes su brtse bas nyer dgongs nas// byin gyis rlob par mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyi mdzub mo brkyang pa'i rtse sprad pas/ oṃ badz+ra maṇ+ḍa la ut+tiṣ+ṭha/ sta gon gyi lha nam mkhar btegs par gyur/ zhes sta gon grub bo// de nas bum pa gzhung bzhin sgrub/ de nas tshogs nas/ rjes chog bkra shis bcas legs par grub bo// ༈ //karma legs bshad gling gi bshad grwa ru// bla ma bsod nams rab rgyas zhes bya bas// gzhan phan lhag bsam bzang po'i mthus bskyed kyis// spar du bsgrubs dges 'gro kun 'tshang rgya shog /sarba maṅga laṃ/ dge'o/// /
